name: com.bnc.gimac.android.bnccomponentlibrary.FlutterBaseActivity
description: When the app opens an embedded Flutter screen from BNC GIMAC, this Activity provides the page frame and applies the app's status bar and back-button behavior. Disabling it can prevent screens built on this base from opening.
disableEffect: BNC GIMAC pages that use this screen base may fail to open or return correctly.
